hooks.command: $d='C:\Users\Joel\.claude'; $t=(Get-Date -f yyyyMMdd); $f="$d\sm-pulled-$t.flag"; if(!(Test-Path $f)){Write-Host 'Pulling latest from remote...'; git -C 'C:/Projects/supermom' pull --ff-only 2>&1|Out-Host; New-Item $f -ItemType File -Force|Out-Null; Get-ChildItem "$d\sm-pulled-*.flag"|Where-Object {$_.Name -ne "sm-pulled-$t.flag"}|Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}; exit 0

git -C 'C:/Projects/supermom' fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 | Out-Null; $b = git -C 'C:/Projects/supermom' branch -r --list 'origin/claude/*' 2>&1; if ($b) { Write-Host 'Report-only: remote claude/* branches exist (not merged, not pushed to):'; $b | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" } } ; exit 0
